_note: Source-of-truth for every file under public/audio/. public/audio/ itself is gitignored (same reasoning as public/rooms/ - regenerable, large, not source), so this manifest is what makes the audio pipeline auditable and re-fetchable. tools/vendor-audio.mjs reads this and pulls each entry's `source` into `public/audio/<file>` if it isn't already there. Never add a file to public/audio/ without an entry here - an untracked file has no license on record and no way to be re-fetched on a clean checkout.
_radioNote: Fallout-style: a small number of STATIONS, each a looping playlist of several tracks - not one station per track. `station` on each track is the grouping key; ambientSound.ts builds RADIO_STATIONS from the distinct station ids present here, in the order their first track appears.

old-concert-hall.name: The Old Concert Hall
old-concert-hall.description: Western orchestral and piano - the station for a quiet town or a long walk on a trade road.

six-strings.name: Six Strings
six-strings.description: Guitar and lute, solo. The station for a tavern corner or a camp fire.

silk-road.name: The Silk Road
silk-road.description: Chinese, Japanese and Arabic traditional and traditional-style instrumental music.

salt-and-sail.name: Salt and Sail
salt-and-sail.description: Sea shanties and nautical folk - the station for a harbor town, a ship, or anywhere the pirates are.

halls-of-shadow.name: Halls of Shadow
halls-of-shadow.description: Dark, dramatic orchestral and piano - the station for a crypt, a haunted ruin, or anywhere the dead don't stay down. Split out from The Old Concert Hall (28 Aug 2026) because Brahms' turbulent later movements suit those zones far better than they suit a town square.

throne-and-temple.name: Throne and Temple
throne-and-temple.description: Grand, ceremonial orchestral music - the station for a palace, a great hall, a coronation, or a temple in full ceremony.
